jobs.title: ServiceNow Developer
jobs.description: Key Responsibilities Design, develop and implement solutions on the ServiceNow platform, with a primary focus on the CSM module. Customize and configure ServiceNow components, including forms, workflows, business rules, client scripts, UI policies, UI actions and notifications. Develop and manage REST and SOAP integrations with external systems. Analyse business requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Troubleshoot issues, perform root cause analysis and deliver timely fixes. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth implementation and continuous improvement of ServiceNow applications. Follow best practices for ServiceNow development, documentation and version control. Required Experience & Skills 3–6+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development. Strong expertise in the CSM (Customer Service Management) module, including configuration, case management, workflows, portals and integrations. Practical experience with REST and SOAP APIs and building integrations with ServiceNow. Strong understanding of JavaScript, Glide APIs, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub and ServiceNow platform capabilities. Ability to work independently as well as in a collaborative team environment. Good communication and problem-solving skills. Nice to Have ServiceNow certifications such as CSA, CAD, CIS-CSM or other relevant module certifications. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments. Knowledge of ITIL processes.

jobs.title: Line manager HVDC Service Warranty & Care
jobs.description: The opportunity HVDC (High Voltage Direct Current) is a product group in Hitachi Energy, which develops, manufactures, and sells DC transmission systems on a global market. HVDC technology is used to transmit electricity over long distances and for power transmission via submarine cables. It is also used to connect power systems. HVDC Service, based in Ludvika, Sweden, is now looking for a Line Manager to take on the role as the leader for the Service Warranty & Care to support and develop the individuals and the group. In this role, you will have personnel responsibility for a team of 10-20 professionals reporting directly to you. You will be tasked with ensuring that engineering teams are adequately resourced, developed, and equipped to meet business needs, as well as ensuring that the company's culture and values are reflected in all employee practices and policies. Your primary objective will be to motivate and engage your team and to support them to achieve their full potential, while ensuring compliance with all relevant regulations. Your Responsibilities HVDC Services core is to lead and manage employee relations, development and engage relations to foster a sense of community among employees. Building and developing the team and the individuals in it by managing employee training and development initiatives Providing strategic direction, leadership, and coordination of the function and operational work together with technical specialists. Providing insight and managing priorities for the team while ensuring activities’ performance and quality goals are met during all project phases. Taking a proactive approach and actively participating in recruiting activities. Planning for project staffing and adjusting it according to business needs, as well as planning for both short-term and more strategic long-term changes in the team structure. Partnering with the management team to develop, improve, and implement strategic people management initiatives and ensuring processes are in place to capture and share best practices and operational experiences. Your Background Experience as a people manager, or other relevant leadership or management experience with personnel responsibility, is highly qualifying. Experience in technology, engineering, electrical design, hardware design, or similar is required (if you have worked with HVDC technology before it is a plus). Strong communication, social, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build strong relationships with employees and management. Clear in decision making and have the right inner drive to take on full responsibility for your scope and deliver on time in a dynamic environment. Fluency in Swedish and English is a must. More About Us​ We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together. ​ Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes: ​ Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2) ​ Group life insurance and additional insurances. ​ Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank ​ Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager) ​ Health care and wellness allowance ​ Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)​ Psychological support program ​ Supplementary compensation for parental leave ​ Various training and education supporting employee development ​ Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally ​ Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks ​ The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. jobs.title: Delivery Manager Software Development & Service Delivery - 20156
jobs.description: Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry. Job Overview Assignment Description We are looking for a Delivery Manager. What You Will Work On Coordinate daily delivery activities and manage operational delivery communication. Lead sprint planning, estimation, sprint commitments, and structured follow-up with customer team leads. Conduct biweekly reviews of sprint performance, delivery outcomes, lessons learned, deviations, and agreed performance criteria. Hold individual discussions with developers as needed, coordinating with customer team leads. Coordinate multiple team leads, delivery managers, and other stakeholders involved in team performance. Manage operational escalations and raise critical issues to the Key Account Manager (KAM) when required. Work with the Resource Manager to prioritise capacity and competence requirements across teams. Provide delivery data and risk assessments for forecasts, invoicing, quarterly reviews, and business follow-ups. Manage and approve consultant holidays and work-from-home requests. Monitor team sickness absence and ensure relevant information reaches the appropriate stakeholders. What You Bring Experience in delivery management, project management, or IT service delivery. Experience coordinating software development teams and multiple stakeholders. Strong understanding of Agile delivery, sprint planning, estimation, and performance follow-up. Ability to manage operational risks, escalations, and delivery commitments. Experience with capacity planning, resource coordination, and delivery reporting. Strong communication, coordination, and leadership skills. Ability to work in a structured, client-facing environment and drive continuous improvement. Meritorious Experience managing software development deliveries across multiple teams. Experience with contractual delivery commitments, forecasting, and invoicing support. Experience working with Key Account Managers and Resource Managers. Experience with performance reviews, risk management, and quarterly business follow-ups.

jobs.title: Service Sales Manager
jobs.description: Build Customer Relationships and Grow Service Business as a Service Sales Manager Are you an energetic and results-oriented person who wants to move our customers’ performance forward? Join us as a Service Sales Manager and play a key role in strengthening our service presence across Sweden. In this position, you will work closely with customers in the process industry, develop long-term relationships, and identify new service opportunities that improve plant reliability, safety, and performance. You will be an important part of our Nordic service organization, helping customers get the most out of their installed valve base while contributing to the continued growth of our service business. Flexible location within Sweden, preferably in Northern Sweden. Your responsibilities You will drive service sales activities across Sweden, with a primary focus on customers in the northern parts of the country. You will build and maintain strong relationships with existing and new customers, identifying opportunities to support their reliability and performance goals. You will collaborate closely with our service organization and authorized service partners to expand our service presence and strengthen customer support. You will promote and sell maintenance, repair, and operational services, as well as develop opportunities for long-term service agreements. You will act as a trusted partner to customers, understanding their business needs and translating them into value-adding service solutions. Expectations for you You have a technical background within the process industry. You are customer-focused and skilled at building long-term customer relationships and identifying business opportunities. Experience in valve technology, flow control solutions, or the process industry is considered an advantage. You hold a valid driver’s license. You communicate confidently in Swedish and English. Willingness and ability to travel and actively visit customers. To succeed in this role To succeed, you need a strong understanding of industrial service business and the ability to create trust-based customer relationships. You combine commercial drive with technical curiosity and enjoy spending time close to customers to understand their challenges and future plans. Experience from valves, maintenance services, or process industries will help you identify opportunities where our services can improve reliability, safety, and operational performance. We offer You will join Valmet’s Sales and Services Region within Flow Control Scandinavia, Sweden, where the focus is on growing the installed base business and helping customers achieve their safety, availability, and reliability goals. The team works closely with customers throughout the lifecycle of their equipment, developing service solutions that maximize plant uptime and performance. A key part of the strategy is expanding local service presence and building strong customer relationships through dedicated teams and a network of service partners. This is an opportunity to have a real impact on the growth of the service business while working in a customer-focused and international environment. Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position with excellent opportunities for professional growth. We value our employees and provide modern tools, learning opportunities, flexible ways of working, and a collaborative culture where innovation and customer success go hand in hand. Want to know more? Did we catch your interest? Please submit your application as soon as possible via the link below, as interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis. The final application deadline is November 8, 2026. For further information about the position, please contact Torbjörn Mattsson, Manager Sub-Regional Sales & Service at torbjorn.mattsson@valmet.com.
